topic: Panmunjom blue huts on the Korean border
hook: Your next step can cross into North Korea.
title: One Room That Sits in Two Countries
description:
On the Panmunjom tour, blue huts sit right on the line between North and South Korea. Inside the meeting room, you can stand on both sides of the border. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #Korea
